blocks.text:
Granada was founded in 1524 and is considered the oldest colonial city on the American mainland. Over its history, the city has survived pirate attacks, civil wars and fires.

During the tour, you will visit the main square, the Casa de los Leones cultural centre, the San Francisco museum and convent, the Ceramics Museum, La Merced church and La Calzada street.

The route then continues to Managua, Nicaragua's capital since 1852, on the shores of Lake Xolotlán. The sightseeing tour introduces you to the historic centre, Central Park, the ruins of Santiago Cathedral, the National Palace of Culture and the Rubén Darío Theatre.

A visit to Tiscapa Historical Park is also planned, with panoramic views of the city, the lake and Tiscapa Lagoon.

After Managua, you will travel to Masaya Volcano National Park, the country's first and largest national park. Here you can see Masaya Volcano and its active crater. The day ends with a visit to the Masaya craft market.

Return to Granada. Overnight at La Gran Francia.
**Meals:** breakfast.
